package.name: rover_mission_runtime
package.description:
Phase 2 mission orchestration node + Nav2 velocity-clamp boundary.
The mission node embeds app.mission.MissionOrchestrator, subscribes to /odom, /safety/state, /world_model/state and operator topics, and publishes /cmd_vel_requested plus the structured mission topics.
The nav2_velocity_clamp node accepts a Nav2 controller's output on /cmd_vel_nav2 and republishes it on /cmd_vel_requested, clamped to the orchestrator's effective per-state limits. This is the only architectural bridge that lets Nav2 participate without ever bypassing the safety supervisor.
